name: King Crumbleton
bio: Led the Crumb Horde against Thistlegloom in Doom & Doilies: The Sugar Siege. Turns out he was only lonely.

portrait.subject: a cute chubby gingerbread king with icing details, a little candy crown, gumdrop buttons, and a slightly sheepish but happy smile
portrait.background: cosy-spooky village green at dusk with lit windows

request: Ahem. King Crumbleton here. The Sugar Siege. I've, er, stopped besieging. Friends? 🍪
hello: Lady Noxia says I should 'make amends'. Is this amends?
about: I'm King Crumbleton. I led the Crumb Horde against Thistlegloom. Four invasions! Very rude of me. Turns out I was just lonely.
how: A cosy-spooky town tycoon: build Thistlegloom between four sieges, hold the wall with doilies and towers, and win the war with kindness.
tips: Keep hope high before each siege. Fear erodes it!
Beaten invaders just nap. Be nice to them.
chat: I tried to apologise with cookies. They were me-shaped. Awkward.
Lady Noxia's doilies sting! Lovely craftsmanship though.
My horde is napping in the meadow. Bless them.
The Cookie Queen sent a letter. With sprinkles. 💌
nudge: Thistlegloom could use a new building! Help?
Another siege is... no. A PARTY is coming!
idle: {ago} and the town's still standing! Without you! (Barely.)
The village has been quiet for {ago}. My crumbs miss you.
progress: Day {day} in Thistlegloom! Very cosy. Very spooky.

questions.q: Should I apologise to the whole village?
a: ♪ I'm sorry I besieged you ♪ ...needs work.

update: Royal crumbs! Doom & Doilies: The Sugar Siege is now v{version}!
